faq.question_en: Which Malaysian Standard applies to halal cosmetics?
faq.question_bm: Standard Malaysia yang mana terpakai untuk kosmetik halal?
faq.answer_formal_en: MS 2634:2019 Halal cosmetics – General requirements (First revision). It replaced MS 2200-1:2008, which Standards Malaysia lists as withdrawn. Certification itself follows the Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020 (MPPHM 2020), and the internal halal control system follows the Malaysian Halal Management System 2020 (MHMS 2020).
faq.answer_layman_en: For cosmetics the halal standard is MS 2634:2019. MS 2200 is withdrawn. The how-to-apply rules are in MPPHM 2020 and the in-house system in MHMS 2020.
faq.answer_formal_bm: MS 2634:2019 Halal cosmetics – General requirements (Semakan pertama). Ia menggantikan MS 2200-1:2008 yang disenaraikan oleh Jabatan Standard Malaysia sebagai telah ditarik balik. Pensijilan mengikut Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020 (MPPHM 2020), dan sistem kawalan halal dalaman mengikut Malaysian Halal Management System 2020 (MHMS 2020).
faq.answer_layman_bm: Untuk kosmetik, standard halalnya ialah MS 2634:2019. MS 2200 sudah ditarik balik. Cara memohon ada dalam MPPHM 2020 dan sistem dalaman syarikat dalam MHMS 2020.

faq.question_en: Does a halal-certified premise still need a KKM food premise licence?
faq.question_bm: Adakah premis bersijil halal masih perlu lesen premis makanan KKM?
faq.answer_formal_en: Yes. Halal certification (JAKIM / JAIN / MAIN) and food-safety registration with the Ministry of Health (Food Act 1983 and Food Regulations 1985; MeSTI or HACCP where applicable) are separate requirements and both apply. [SAHKAN: which registration the premise category requires]
faq.answer_layman_en: Two different doors: halal is JAKIM, food safety is KKM. You need both.
faq.answer_formal_bm: Ya. Pensijilan halal (JAKIM / JAIN / MAIN) dan pendaftaran keselamatan makanan dengan Kementerian Kesihatan (Akta Makanan 1983 dan Peraturan-Peraturan Makanan 1985; MeSTI atau HACCP jika berkenaan) ialah keperluan berasingan dan kedua-duanya terpakai. [SAHKAN: pendaftaran yang diperlukan mengikut kategori premis]
faq.answer_layman_bm: Dua pintu berbeza: halal ialah JAKIM, keselamatan makanan ialah KKM. Kedua-duanya perlu.

faq.question_en: Is a cosmetic product with a halal certificate exempt from NPRA notification?
faq.question_bm: Adakah produk kosmetik yang mempunyai sijil halal dikecualikan daripada notifikasi NPRA?
faq.answer_formal_en: No. Notifikasi Kosmetik with NPRA under the Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984 is required before a cosmetic is marketed in Malaysia, regardless of halal status. The halal certificate is a separate voluntary scheme.
faq.answer_layman_en: Halal does not replace NPRA. Notify first, then market.
faq.answer_formal_bm: Tidak. Notifikasi Kosmetik dengan NPRA di bawah Peraturan-Peraturan Kawalan Dadah dan Kosmetik 1984 diperlukan sebelum kosmetik dipasarkan di Malaysia, tanpa mengira status halal. Sijil halal ialah skim sukarela yang berasingan.
faq.answer_layman_bm: Halal tidak menggantikan NPRA. Notifikasi dahulu, baru pasarkan.

guidelines.title: Manual Prosedur Pensijilan Halal Malaysia (Domestik) 2020
guidelines.summary_en: MPPHM 2020: application, audit, certification, monitoring and enforcement of the Malaysian halal certificate. Listed as the current manual on the Halal Malaysia portal (checked 14 Oct 2026).
guidelines.summary_bm: MPPHM 2020: permohonan, audit, pensijilan, pemantauan dan penguatkuasaan Sijil Pengesahan Halal Malaysia. Disenaraikan sebagai manual semasa di Portal Halal Malaysia (disemak 14 Okt 2026).

guidelines.title: Malaysian Halal Management System (MHMS) 2020
guidelines.summary_en: Internal halal control: Internal Halal Control System for micro and small firms, Halal Assurance System for large firms. Replaced the Guideline for Halal Assurance Management System.
guidelines.summary_bm: Kawalan halal dalaman: Sistem Kawalan Halal Dalaman untuk syarikat mikro dan kecil, Sistem Jaminan Halal untuk syarikat besar. Menggantikan Garis Panduan Sistem Pengurusan Jaminan Halal.

guidelines.title: MS 1500:2019 Halal food – General requirements (Third revision)
guidelines.title_bm: MS 1500:2019 Makanan halal – Keperluan umum (Semakan ketiga)
guidelines.summary_en: Manufacturing and handling of halal food, including nutrient supplements. Reconfirmed by Standards Malaysia in 2024.
guidelines.summary_bm: Pengeluaran dan pengendalian makanan halal, termasuk suplemen nutrien. Disahkan semula oleh Jabatan Standard Malaysia pada 2024.

guidelines.title: MS 2634:2019 Halal cosmetics – General requirements (First revision)
guidelines.title_bm: MS 2634:2019 Kosmetik halal – Keperluan umum (Semakan pertama)
guidelines.summary_en: Manufacturing and handling of halal cosmetics. Replaced MS 2200-1:2008 (withdrawn).
guidelines.summary_bm: Pengeluaran dan pengendalian kosmetik halal. Menggantikan MS 2200-1:2008 (ditarik balik).

guidelines.title: Guidelines for Control of Cosmetic Products in Malaysia
guidelines.title_bm: Garis Panduan Kawalan Produk Kosmetik di Malaysia
guidelines.summary_en: NPRA requirements for Notifikasi Kosmetik, ingredient annexes, labelling and claims. [SAHKAN: revision date]
guidelines.summary_bm: Keperluan NPRA untuk Notifikasi Kosmetik, lampiran bahan, pelabelan dan dakwaan. [SAHKAN: tarikh semakan]
